title: Sprint 4 — Indexing & Performance
description: Understand how indexes work, when to use them, and how to analyze and optimize query performance.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Index Fundamentals
tickets.description:
Create single field indexes.
Create compound indexes.
Create unique and sparse indexes.
Create text indexes and search.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.1 — Create Single Field Indexes
tasks.description: Improve query performance by creating indexes on individual fields.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.2 — Compound Indexes
tasks.description: Optimize queries that sort and filter on multiple fields by creating compound indexes.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.3 — Unique & Sparse Indexes
tasks.description: Enforce field uniqueness and create indexes that only include documents with specific fields.

tasks.title: Task 4.1.4 — Text Indexes & Search
tasks.description: Enable powerful text search capabilities across string content within your documents.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Query Performance
tickets.description:
Read and interpret explain.
Build covered queries.
Use index hints and drop indexes.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.1 — Read & Interpret explain()
tasks.description: Analyze the execution plan of a query to understand how MongoDB retrieves the data and identifies performance bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.2 — Covered Queries
tasks.description: Optimize queries so that they can be satisfied entirely using an index without accessing the actual documents.

tasks.title: Task 4.2.3 — Index Hints & Dropping Indexes
tasks.description: Force MongoDB to use a specific index for a query and remove unnecessary indexes.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Schema Design for Performance
tickets.description:
Compare embedding vs referencing.
Apply the bucket pattern.
Solve a data modeling challenge.

tasks.title: Task 4.3.1 — Embedding vs Referencing
tasks.description: Design data models by deciding when to embed data within a document versus when to reference data in another collection.

tasks.title: Task 4.3.2 — The Bucket Pattern
tasks.description: Organize time-series or large sequences of data efficiently using the bucket pattern.

tasks.title: Task 4.3.3 — Data Modeling Challenge
tasks.description: Apply data modeling principles to solve a complex, real-world schema design problem.
